personagens.YARA: a Brazilian woman technician (thirties, brown skin, shoulder-length curly black hair, dark navy work shirt and pants)
personagens.CLIENTE: a Brazilian farmer (fifties, light skin, short gray hair and a neat gray beard, beige button-up shirt and jeans)

gramatica.cenaAbertura: Wide view inside a bright GPS repair workshop, with tools on the walls and a green tractor by the big open door. At the front counter, {YARA} talks with {CLIENTE}, who listens with his arms crossed; a round GPS antenna sits on the counter between them.

slides.cena: Outside the workshop, beside a green tractor, {YARA} holds up two round GPS antennas, a big one in one hand and a small one in the other, while {CLIENTE} compares them with a curious look.

gramatica.cenaRevisao: Late afternoon at the open workshop door, under a golden sky: {CLIENTE} smiles and shakes hands with {YARA}, holding his phone with a green check mark on the screen. His pickup truck waits outside.
